rationale: The agent authenticated the user via matching email, reviewed the user’s orders with read-only calls, and summarized statuses accurately. Before making any changes, the agent clearly stated the intended actions (cancel both pending orders; initiate return for all items in the delivered non-boot order; no action on the boots) and obtained explicit confirmation. Actions were appropriate to order status (cancellations on pending; return on delivered) and performed on the authenticated user’s own orders. Refunds for the cancelled orders were correctly reflected by the tools, and the agent correctly calculated and reported the total refunded today ($2,460.21), while clarifying the delivered-order return would be refunded later. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
